description.text:
《About the team》
You'll join ULTRON's product development function, working alongside AI Solutions Engineers who handle cloud infrastructure, API services, and ML-powered features.
This isn't a large team with layers of management — it's a lean, high-autonomy environment where each builder owns complete products. You'll collaborate directly with business teams to understand market needs and with the CEO on product direction.
The team operates with an AI-native mindset: we use AI tools not as occasional helpers, but as core multipliers of our capability. This isn't just a vision — it's already how we work. Our current builders routinely orchestrate AI agents to ship products faster than traditional teams, and we're continuously pushing the boundaries of what one skilled person can achieve with the right tools.
《What You'll Do》
You will be a Senior IoT Product Builder who can independently develop complete IoT products from embedded firmware to mobile apps, using AI-native development approaches.
What makes this different:
● You won't need to hand-write every line of code — you'll use AI tools to accelerate development.
● You'll own entire products, not just features.
● You'll work on different products based on your strengths and market needs.
● You'll collaborate with business teams to build products that actually sell.
1. Independent Product Development (70%)
You'll be the primary owner of IoT products from concept to deployment.
● Full-Stack IoT Development
○ Design and develop ESP firmware for device control and sensor data collection.
○ Build cross-platform mobile/web apps for device control and data visualization.
○ Design and implement product-specific APIs independently; collaborate with the backend members only for core infrastructure APIs.
○ Ensure products are stable, user-friendly, and ready for real customers.
● AI-Assisted Development Approach
○ Use AI coding tools to accelerate prototyping, code generation, and iteration.
○ You're not expected to hand-code everything — AI handles routine code generation while you focus on architecture, quality assurance, and edge cases.
○ Development timelines vary by complexity; AI tools help most with well-defined tasks and less with hardware debugging or integration challenges.
2. Collaboration & Problem Solving（20%）
● With AI Solutions Engineer
○ Define AI/ML capabilities needed for your product and collaborate on feasibility.
○ Integrate cloud APIs and ML models into your applications.
○ Provide feedback on API performance, data formats, and real-time requirements.
● With Business Team
○ Understand customer pain points and market needs.
○ Demo products to clients and gather feedback.
○ Balance feature requests with development feasibility.
3. Continuous Learning & Optimization（10%）
● Explore new IoT technologies, components, and AI development tools.
● Optimize and document development workflows.
● Share knowledge and best practices with team members.
● Stay current with industry trends in IoT and energy management.
《Why Join Us》
Work at the Frontier of AI-Assisted Development
● One of Taiwan's few companies genuinely practicing AI-native development workflows.
● Develop skills that define the next decade of engineering productivity.
● Learn directly from leadership who actively works this way.
High Autonomy & Meaningful Challenge
● Create products from scratch, not just build what others designed.
● Direct collaboration with business leadership and CEO.
● Every product is a new challenge and learning opportunity.
Real Impact
● ULTRON's products genuinely improve energy efficiency and reduce waste.
● Your products will be used by real customers in real buildings.
● Direct contribution to sustainability goals.
Growth Opportunity
● Cross-domain growth across IoT, AI, and product development.
● Future opportunities to lead teams or become a technical leader.
● Shape the direction of new product lines.

key_values.label: 工作技能
key_values.text: 軟體工程系統開發、系統架構規劃、系統整合分析、韌體工程開發、網路資料傳輸、無線通訊技術開發、整合無線通訊模組、功能測試(function test)、問題追蹤處理(Bug tracking)、韌體整合測試、硬體整合測試、軟體整合測試、微電腦軟體設計、模組化系統設計、AI、語言模型、提示工程、生成式AI

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
《Required Qualifications》
1. Background & Experience
● 3+ years of IoT product development experience with demonstrated ability to build complete products from scratch (0 to 1).
● Independent problem-solving mindset: when stuck, you find solutions through documentation, experimentation, and AI assistance without constant guidance.
● Embedded Development
○ At least 2 complete projects using Arduino framework or ESP-IDF (ESP32/ESP8266).
○ Solid understanding of GPIO, PWM, ADC, I2C, SPI.
○ WiFi/BLE connectivity management and OTA update implementation.
● Mobile/Web App Development
○ Experience with React Native, Flutter, or Progressive Web Apps.
○ Real-time data display and intuitive IoT control interface design.
● IoT Architecture
○ Working knowledge of MQTT, WebSocket, HTTP/HTTPS.
○ Understanding of device ↔ cloud ↔ app data flow.
○ Ability to design and implement RESTful APIs independently.
2. Language & Communication
● Native or fluent Mandarin Chinese.
● Professional working proficiency in English (TOEIC 700+ or equivalent) for reading technical documentation and interacting with AI tools.
《Preferred》
● Experience using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) in actual projects — not just asking ChatGPT questions, but driving AI to produce working, production-ready code.
● Portfolio showcasing AI-assisted development (GitHub, technical blog).
● Experience in smart home, smart lighting, or energy management products.
● Basic understanding of ML/AI concepts.
● Experience integrating third-party AI APIs (OpenAI, Google AI, etc.).
● Understanding of prompt engineering best practices.
《Compensation》
Salary Range: NT$ 1,000,000 - 2,000,000 annually (based on experience and demonstrated capabilities).
Product Bonus: Additional performance-based bonus tied to your product's profitability.
《Career Progression》
● First 6 Months：
○ Familiarize yourself with ULTRON's products and technology stack.
○ Independently complete 1-2 full products from concept to deployment.
○ Establish effective collaboration workflows with business, ML, and backend teams.
○ Develop proficiency in ULTRON's AI-assisted development processes.
● Year 1-2：
○ Become ULTRON's core IoT product development expert.
○ Lead more complex and larger-scale product initiatives.
○ Develop sophisticated AI agent workflows to multiply your output.
○ Participate in product strategy discussions and roadmap planning.
● Year 2-3 :
○ Orchestrate multiple AI agents to manage parallel product development.
○ Become a recognized practitioner in AI-native IoT development in Taiwan.
○ Opportunity to shape new product line directions.
○ Scale your impact through better tooling, not just more hours.
